title: Evaluating Cross-Session Prompt Injection in MCP-Based AI Agents: Persistence, Security Defenses, and Tool-Use Outcomes
short_description: Ongoing undergraduate final-year research. It is not a publication, and no results are reported yet.
problem: Does attacker-controlled persistent state that survives a session boundary change the likelihood of unintended MCP-mediated actions?
objectives: Evaluate whether cross-session persistence of attacker-controlled state changes the likelihood of unintended MCP-mediated actions.
Evaluate a proposed defense that uses deterministic provenance and trust policies to identify untrusted persistent content before sensitive MCP execution.
Examine tool-use outcomes under the conditions tested.
methodology: The proposed study compares matched P0 and P1 conditions that differ in whether attacker-controlled application state remains retrievable after a session reset. No results are reported.
